value.rationale: The complete finite-n uniform-edge length law supplies all chord moments and a nondegenerate Gamma-scaled local law for a natural random Delaunay/convex-hull mesh. The quadratic edge-energy statistic has a canonical finite-element triangular mesh benchmark; its exact sample-size invariant expected energy/area ratio and sharp comparison to equilateral triangles quantify shape irregularity. This is a meaningful structural metric law, not just a first-moment recomputation.
